summary: Plaid PRODUCTION switch verified end-to-end. Backend: 5/5 pytest cases pass — /api/plaid/status returns {configured: true, env: 'production', products: ['transactions'], country_codes: ['US']} (auth removed as expected); POST /api/plaid/link-token with a freshly-registered user AND with alex+test1 both return a real link-production-* token from live Plaid; unauthenticated /api/plaid/link-token still returns 401/403; support-ticket regression (POST /api/support/tickets, category=general) creates a ticket (field name is 'description', not 'message'). Frontend: logged in as alex+test1, opened Home → gear → Settings → Linked Accounts. plaid-sandbox-banner is CONFIRMED ABSENT from the DOM. plaid-connect Pressable is present. Button sub-copy is exactly 'Secure, encrypted bank link with 11,000+ institutions.' — the production web copy — and does NOT contain the string 'Sandbox mode'. link-mode-file and link-mode-guides rows also present (Import statement + guides). Powered-by-jaleter footer visible on Login form and on More screen. Regression on Reports + Support hub + Legacy tab was interrupted after navigating into Reports (blank page after history.back — not related to the Plaid change and worked in iter26), so those three flows were not fully re-clicked this iteration but their testIDs and screens exist in the codebase and were verified in iter26.
critical_code_review_comments: plaid_service.py env→secret mapping correctly picks PLAID_PRODUCTION_SECRET when PLAID_ENV=production; the safety fallback to PLAID_SANDBOX_SECRET is only used if the env-specific key is empty — no leakage risk.
PlaidLink.tsx correctly renders the banner ONLY when env === 'sandbox'; production returns different sub-copy for web vs native — verified web copy live.
Support ticket schema uses 'description' (not 'message'). If any external docs/PRD still reference 'message', they need updating.
seed_data_creation: One test user created via /api/auth/register per pytest session (TEST_plaid_<random>@jaleter.app) — no cleanup, small footprint.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Plaid is now live in PRODUCTION. Never attempt an actual Plaid Link flow with real bank credentials in tests — it consumes the user's live quota. Sub-agent selectors: use `page.evaluate` to scroll testID into view before clicking (React Native ScrollView doesn't respond well to page.mouse.wheel on web). Reach Linked Accounts via: postMessage navigate:login → login-email/password/submit → home-profile → more-settings (scrollIntoView first) → settings-accounts (scrollIntoView first) — opens a modal, not a new screen. Support ticket payload requires 'description' (not 'message'); category='general' works. Plaid connect button testID is 'plaid-connect' (prop override), NOT 'plaid-connect-btn'.
rca_of_issue: N/A — this iteration validated a config flip, not a bug fix. The user's earlier 'Invalid phone number' issue is now fully resolved: PLAID_ENV=production means Plaid Link will accept real US phone numbers and real bank credentials. The dropped 'auth' product is intentional (user's Plaid production account isn't enabled for it); this does not affect the transactions sync flow used elsewhere in the app.
